sn22.20:1.3: The cause and condition for the arising of form is also nonself.
sn22.20:1.4: As form has originated from what is nonself, how could it be self?
sn22.20:1.9: The cause and condition for the arising of consciousness is also nonself.
sn22.20:1.10: As consciousness has originated from what is nonself, how could it be self?
sn22.20:1.12: He understands: ‘… there is no more for this state of being.’”
